How saving works

Open the editor with Edit Website.cmd. Then Save website updates your portfolio files directly. Refresh the website to see the saved changes.

If you open editor.html directly in Edge or Chrome, you can also select the dist folder once to connect it for direct saving. The browser may ask for folder access again in a later session.

Download pages ZIP is an optional export. Your original video remains in the existing assets folder. Newly chosen media is embedded in the pages.

Download editing draft backs up your editing work. Use Open website or draft to reopen it later.

Ready to edit.Save updates every page. Refresh the website to see your changes.
